+import base64
+import hashlib
+import os
+import secrets
+import urllib.parse
+import webbrowser
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import requests
+
+
+AUTH0_DOMAIN_ENV = "AUTH0_DOMAIN"
+AUTH0_CLIENT_ID_ENV = "AUTH0_CLIENT_ID"
+AUTH0_AUDIENCE_ENV = "AUTH0_AUDIENCE"
+AUTH0_SCOPE_ENV = "AUTH0_SCOPE"
+AUTH0_CALLBACK_URL_ENV = "AUTH0_CALLBACK_URL"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PKCELoginResult:
+    authorization_url: str
+    code_verifier: str
+    code_challenge: str
+    state: str
+
+
+def _b64url_no_padding(raw: bytes) -> str:
+    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")
+
+
+def generate_code_verifier(length: int = 64) -> str:
+    if length < 43 or length > 128:
+        raise ValueError("PKCE code verifier length must be between 43 and 128 characters")
+    return _b64url_no_padding(secrets.token_bytes(length))[:length]
+
+
+def generate_code_challenge(code_verifier: str) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(code_verifier.encode("ascii")).digest()
+    return _b64url_no_padding(digest)
+
+
+def build_auth0_authorization_url(
+    domain: str,
+    client_id: str,
+    redirect_uri: str,
+    scope: str,
+    state: str,
+    code_challenge: str,
+    audience: str | None = None,
+) -> str:
+    params = {
+        "response_type": "code",
+        "client_id": client_id,
+        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
+        "scope": scope,
+        "state": state,
+        "code_challenge": code_challenge,
+        "code_challenge_method": "S256",
+    }
+    if audience:
+        params["audience"] = audience
+    return f"https://{domain}/authorize?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params)}"
+
+
+def start_pkce_login() -> PKCELoginResult:
+    domain = os.environ[AUTH0_DOMAIN_ENV]
+    client_id = os.environ[AUTH0_CLIENT_ID_ENV]
+    redirect_uri = os.environ[AUTH0_CALLBACK_URL_ENV]
+    scope = os.environ.get(AUTH0_SCOPE_ENV, "openid profile email")
+    audience = os.environ.get(AUTH0_AUDIENCE_ENV)
+
+    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
+    code_verifier = generate_code_verifier()
+    code_challenge = generate_code_challenge(code_verifier)
+    authorization_url = build_auth0_authorization_url(
+        domain=domain,
+        client_id=client_id,
+        redirect_uri=redirect_uri,
+        scope=scope,
+        state=state,
+        code_challenge=code_challenge,
+        audience=audience,
+    )
+    webbrowser.open(authorization_url)
+    return PKCELoginResult(
+        authorization_url=authorization_url,
+        code_verifier=code_verifier,
+        code_challenge=code_challenge,
+        state=state,
+    )
+
+
+def exchange_auth0_code_for_tokens(
+    domain: str,
+    client_id: str,
+    code: str,
+    redirect_uri: str,
+    code_verifier: str,
+) -> dict:
+    token_url = f"https://{domain}/oauth/token"
+    response = requests.post(
+        token_url,
+        json={
+            "grant_type": "authorization_code",
+            "client_id": client_id,
+            "code": code,
+            "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
+            "code_verifier": code_verifier,
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+GOOGLE_USERINFO_URL = "https://openidconnect.googleapis.com/v1/userinfo"
+
+
+def fetch_profile_claims(access_token: str, timeout: float = 10.0) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    response = requests.get(
+        GOOGLE_USERINFO_URL,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"},
+        timeout=timeout,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return normalize_profile_claims(response.json())
+
+
+def normalize_profile_claims(claims: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    email = claims.get("email") or claims.get("preferred_username")
+    given_name = claims.get("given_name") or _split_name(claims.get("name"))[0]
+    family_name = claims.get("family_name") or _split_name(claims.get("name"))[1]
+    display_name = claims.get("name") or _join_name(given_name, family_name) or email
+
+    return {
+        "provider": "google",
+        "subject": claims.get("sub"),
+        "email": email,
+        "email_verified": claims.get("email_verified"),
+        "given_name": given_name,
+        "family_name": family_name,
+        "display_name": display_name,
+        "locale": claims.get("locale"),
+        "picture": claims.get("picture"),
+        "raw": claims,
+    }
+
+
+def _split_name(name: Optional[str]) -> tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str]]:
+    if not name:
+        return None, None
+    parts = name.strip().split()
+    if len(parts) == 1:
+        return parts[0], None
+    return parts[0], " ".join(parts[1:])
+
+
+def _join_name(given_name: Optional[str], family_name: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
+    parts = [part for part in (given_name, family_name) if part]
+    return " ".join(parts) if parts else None
+
+
+def get_profile_claims_from_env(timeout: float = 10.0) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    token = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_ACCESS_TOKEN")
+    if not token:
+        raise ValueError("GOOGLE_ACCESS_TOKEN is required")
+    return fetch_profile_claims(token, timeout=timeout)

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+

+
+
+AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.getenv("AUTH0_DOMAIN", "")
+AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.getenv("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID", "")
+AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET = os.getenv("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET", "")
+AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI = os.getenv("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI", "")
+AUTH0_TOKEN_URL = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/oauth/token" if AUTH0_DOMAIN else ""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class OAuthCallbackResult:
+    access_token: str
+    id_token: Optional[str]
+    refresh_token: Optional[str]
+    token_type: Optional[str]
+    expires_in: Optional[int]
+    scope: Optional[str]
+    raw: Dict[str, Any]
+
